get.description:
Returns a paginated list of the individual transactions (captures, refunds, and chargebacks) that make up a single settlement batch.

Use this endpoint for reconciliation when a settlement contains too many transactions to fetch in one response. The settlement detail endpoint (`GET /pg/settlements/{settlement_id}/`) returns every transaction in one unpaginated payload; this endpoint returns the same transactions paginated, with a trimmed field set.

Transactions across all three types are merged into a single stream ordered by `created_at` descending. For a PSP, supply the optional `X-Merchant-ID` header to scope the response to a single sub-merchant.

parameters.name: X-Merchant-ID
parameters.description: PSP only. When supplied, scopes the response to the named sub-merchant. When omitted, a PSP sees its own and all sub-merchants' transactions.

post.description: Create a Virtual Bank Account for the authenticated merchant. VBA details (email, name, phone, virtual_account_id) are derived from the merchant account. From v2.0.0 onwards, a merchant can have multiple ACTIVE VBAs simultaneously. The request body is optional — both `remitter_lock_details` and `amount_lock_details` are independently optional and can be omitted, sent individually, or sent together. When omitted, the corresponding field is returned as `null` and the VBA accepts transfers from any remitter / for any amount.

remitter_lock_details.description: Optional. Omit to allow transfers from any remitter. When supplied, restricts the VBA to accept transfers only from the listed remitter accounts. Persisted on the VBA and echoed back on every read.

amount_lock_details.description: Optional. Omit to allow transfers of any amount. When supplied, restricts the VBA to accept transfers within the given range.

remitter_lock_details.description: The remitter lock applied at creation time, persisted from the gateway response. `null` when no lock was supplied.

amount_lock_details.description: The amount lock applied at creation time. `null` when no lock was supplied.

400.description: Validation error — invalid lock details, merchant account not identified, or email required

403.description: VBA feature not enabled for merchant

500.description: Failed to generate unique virtual_account_id or configuration error

remarks.description: Optional. Payer narration stored on the payment as payment_message. Applied for ICICI VBAs; ignored for Cashfree VBAs (Cashfree's simulate API has no narration field).

parameters.name: virtual_account_id
parameters.description: Virtual account ID of the VBA.

status.description: Effective payment status. `PENDING` — created, awaiting completion. `CAPTURED` — money received. `FAILED` — failed or expired past `expiry_date`. `INVALID` — marked invalid by the gateway.

get.description: Get a paginated list of payments collected on a Virtual Bank Account for the authenticated merchant, sorted by `created_at` descending. Supports incremental sync via time-window filters (`created_at_*` / `updated_at_*`) and a cursor (`since_id` — payment_id of the last record already synced).

parameters.name: virtual_account_id
parameters.description: Virtual account ID of the VBA.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Number of items per page. Default is 250, maximum is 1000.

parameters.name: created_at_start
parameters.description: Include payments with `created_at >= value`. ISO 8601 datetime, e.g. `2026-05-12T00:00:00Z`.

parameters.name: created_at_end
parameters.description: Include payments with `created_at <= value`. ISO 8601 datetime.

parameters.name: updated_at_start
parameters.description: Include payments with `last_updated_at >= value`. ISO 8601 datetime.

parameters.name: updated_at_end
parameters.description: Include payments with `last_updated_at <= value`. ISO 8601 datetime.

parameters.name: since_id
parameters.description: Cursor: `payment_id` of the last record already synced. Only payments created strictly after that one are returned. If `since_id` doesn't match a payment under this VBA, the API returns `400`.

payment_id.description: EximPe payment identifier (UID). Stable, use as primary key.

order_id.description: EximPe order UID this payment belongs to.

status.description: Effective payment status. `PENDING` — created, awaiting completion. `CAPTURED` — money received. `FAILED` — failed or expired past `expiry_date`. `INVALID` — marked invalid by the gateway.

amount.description: Order amount in major units (INR). May be `null` if the order is missing.

payment_utr.description: Bank UTR / transaction reference. Empty string if not yet known.

buyer_account_number.description: Remitter (buyer) bank account number captured from the Cashfree VBA success webhook. `null` when not provided by the bank.

buyer_ifsc.description: Remitter (buyer) bank IFSC code captured from the same webhook. `null` when not provided.

400.description: Validation error. Examples: `created_at_start` / `created_at_end` / `updated_at_start` / `updated_at_end` not a valid ISO 8601 datetime, `since_id` does not match any payment for this VBA, invalid pagination, or `virtual_account_id` missing in path.

details.chargeback: Chargebacks on this payment cannot be answered yet: the PayU chargeback credentials are not configured for this merchant. Please contact support.

404.description: No chargeback with this ID on your payments (or your sub-merchants' payments).

502.description: The gateway couldn't be reached or didn't give a usable response. Nothing was recorded; retry after a few minutes.

details.chargeback: PayU's chargeback reasons are unavailable right now; please try again in a few minutes.

post.description: Answer a chargeback with an action and one of its conditions. Send `multipart/form-data` (needed for documents); an answer with no documents may be sent as JSON instead. A chargeback takes one answer: once it is in, the chargeback moves to `PENDING_DOC_REVIEW` and a second answer is refused with `409`.

action.description: `accept`: accept the chargeback in full. `contest`: dispute it with evidence. `partial_accept`: accept part of the disputed amount.

condition.description: A condition listed under `action` by Get Chargeback Actions.

amount.description: `partial_accept` only, and required there: the amount you accept, less than the disputed amount. Two decimals.

schema.description: Plus one `fields[<name>]` part per field of the chosen condition, with the names from Get Chargeback Actions: the text for a text field, `true` or `false` for a true/false field, and the file for a document. See the request examples.

fields.description: Text and true/false values by field name. Documents need multipart.

fields.reason: Duplicate charge confirmed with the customer

201.description: Answer recorded and sent to the gateway. Returns the chargeback, now `PENDING_DOC_REVIEW`, with your answer.

data.reason_description: Goods or Services Not Provided / Not Received

400.description: The answer is invalid. `details` is keyed by the field at fault: `action`, `condition`, `amount` or a field name of the condition. Nothing was recorded.

details.courier_name: Text field 'courier_name' must not contain any of < > [ ] { }
details.tracking: Not a field of this condition.

403.description: The chargeback can't be answered yet because the payment's chargeback credentials are not configured for this merchant. Contact EximPe support; retrying will not help.

details.chargeback: Chargebacks on this payment cannot be answered yet: the PayU chargeback credentials are not configured for this merchant. Please contact support.

404.description: No chargeback with this ID on your payments (or your sub-merchants' payments).

409.description: The chargeback can no longer be answered: it has an answer already, is closed, or another answer to it is in progress.

error.message: This chargeback can no longer be responded to.

502.description: Either the gateway failed and nothing was recorded (`ERR_PAYMENT_003`; retry), or the gateway accepted some of your documents and then failed (`40670`). For `40670` the contest **is registered** and the chargeback is `PENDING_DOC_REVIEW`: do not resubmit. `details.failed` names the documents that did not arrive; send them to EximPe support.

partially_delivered.summary: Some documents did not reach the gateway

error.message: The contest is registered, but some evidence documents did not reach the gateway. Do not resubmit; the failed documents are listed.

details.chargeback: The gateway accepted some evidence documents and then failed; the contest is registered without the rest.
PayU's chargeback reasons are unavailable right now; please try again in a few minutes.

v2_ChargebackStatus.description: Where the chargeback is in its lifecycle. It can be answered only while `NEW`, `PENDING_RESPONSE` or `INSUFFICIENT_DOCUMENT` (see `can_respond`). `PENDING_DOC_REVIEW`: your answer is in. `SUBMITTED_TO_BANK`: your answer has gone to the bank. `CLOSED_*`: decided.

v2_ChargebackActionType.description: `accept`: accept the chargeback in full. `contest`: dispute it with evidence. `partial_accept`: accept part of the disputed amount.

payment_id.description: The disputed payment.

order_id.description: EximPe order ID of the disputed payment.

order_reference_id.description: Your own reference for the order.

amount.description: Disputed amount, two decimals, in the payment's currency.

action.description: How the chargeback was answered; `null` until it is.

chargeback_type.description: Kind of dispute raised by the customer's bank.

reason_description.description: Why the customer disputed the payment.
reason_description.example: Goods or Services Not Provided / Not Received

respond_by.description: Answer before this time. With no answer by then, the dispute is closed in the customer's favour.

can_respond.description: Whether the chargeback can be answered now.

v2_ChargebackAnswer.description: Your latest answer, or `null` if there is none.

condition.description: The condition you answered with. `null` for an answer given from the merchant dashboard.

v2_ChargebackCondition.description: One way to answer the chargeback, and what it takes.

actions.description: Conditions by action. Only the actions and conditions the payment can be answered with are present; empty once the chargeback can no longer be answered.

clientAuth.description: **Client Application ID** - Your unique application identifier used to authenticate API requests. You can find your Client ID in the Developer Settings section of the merchant dashboard.

clientSecretAuth.name: X-Client-Secret
clientSecretAuth.description: **Client Secret Key** - Your secret key used alongside the Client ID for secure authentication. Keep this confidential and never expose it in client-side code. Available in the Developer Settings section of the merchant dashboard.

merchantAuth.name: X-Merchant-ID
merchantAuth.description: **Merchant Identifier** - The unique ID for the merchant account. This is required for PSP (Payment Service Provider) merchants who manage multiple merchant accounts. You can find merchant IDs in the Merchant Management section of the dashboard.

apiVersionHeader.name: X-API-Version
apiVersionHeader.description: **API Version** - Specifies which version of the API to use (e.g., '1.X.X', '2.X.X', or '3.X.X'). This header allows you to control which API version your integration uses. Default version information is available in the Developer Settings.
